title: On $η$-periodic Formal Ternary Laws
summary: We study the algebraic structure underlying Sp-orientations in the $η$-periodic motivic stable homotopy category $SH(k)[η^{-1}]$. Borel classes determine a geometric formal ternary law, but the HW-Hurewicz map shows that its universal coefficients generate a proper $W(k)$-subalgebra $Λ\subsetneq (MSp[η^{-1}])_*$, although $Λ[1/2]=(MSp[η^{-1}])_*[1/2]$. Thus the failure of generation is purely 2-primary. To capture part of the missing information, we introduce framed involutions.
